title: PlatformConfigurationContent
description:
The values of level 1 (constitution XI), without the version that names them: what an operator publishes. The version is **minted by OPE** from the position in the level's history (`platform-3`), so nothing here declares one — until feature 036 the release file carried a version of its own and nothing forced anyone to change it when the content did.

It is not an `allOf` of `PlatformConfiguration` minus a field, for the same reason as `TreatmentDefaultsContent`: `additionalProperties: false` does not compose through `allOf`.

$schema.description: Path of this schema, for the editor.

eventPastToleranceMs.description: Milliseconds an event instant may sit in the past (late uploads).

clockSkewToleranceMs.description: Milliseconds an instant a client declares may sit in the future.

sessionDurationMs.description: Milliseconds of inactivity after which a session is over and the SDK must mint a new `sessionId`. It is a rule of the backend that the SDK obeys, not an observation the client makes (feature 032).

visitorWindowMs.description: Milliseconds a visitor's interventions count for the fatigue limit.

signatureWindowMs.description: Milliseconds a platform signature's timestamp may sit from the server clock, either way (ADR-029).

rotationGraceMaxMs.description: Longest grace a credential rotation may give the previous credential.

anchorDiagnosticsKept.description: Anchor diagnostics kept per merchant at most.

unmappedValuesKept.description: Unmapped attribute labels kept per merchant at most; past it the oldest is dropped and the catalogue is never refused.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Seconds a client waits before retrying a write a store could not accept: the `Retry-After` of every 503 (ADR-021).

platformSyncTickMs.description: Milliseconds between two looks of the platform scheduler at what is due: the pulls whose cadence elapsed and the notices whose retry came (ADR-047). A cadence shorter than the tick runs at the tick.

DedupWindow.description: The deduplication window of the ingestion (ADR-024): ids older than the TTL or beyond the budget are forgotten.

ttlMs.description: Milliseconds an event id is remembered.

maxIds.description: Ids remembered per merchant at most.
